title: SummaryResponseToSlack
description: summary-posted's reply to a slash command (HTTP 200, application/json), exactly as sent: text shown to the user who ran the command (ephemeral) or to the whole channel (in_channel). The acknowledgement of a started /meetingsummary job is in_channel and its text holds the marker "(job <reference>)": process-summary finds the acknowledgement again in channel history by that marker (job_reference in handoff_to_process_summary). The other replies are for a command that is not /meetingsummary, a /meetingsummary without text, and a summary that is too long to process. project-added also sends ephemeral replies of this shape to /setup (an unknown command, or a modal that could not be opened); architecture §8 lists no schema of their own for them.
